fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: How you’d like us to greet you in emails.
fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase is easier to remember.
fields.phoneHint: Only to coordinate the delivery of your orders.

fieldErrors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, for example name@domain.com.
fieldErrors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
fieldErrors.passwordTooLong: The password can have up to 128 characters.
fieldErrors.passwordTooCommon: That password is one of the most used. Choose another one.
fieldErrors.invalidPhone: Use only numbers, spaces or hyphens, with a leading + if needed.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password isn’t correct.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_one: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} second and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_other: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} seconds and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_minutes_one: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} minute and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_minutes_other: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} minutes and try again.
errors.CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: For your security, complete the check below and try again.
errors.CHALLENGE_FAILED: We couldn’t confirm the check. Please try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: This account is blocked and can’t sign in.
errors.INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_TOKEN: The link expired or was already used.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: The page was open for a long time. Reload it and try again.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.

turnstile.label: Security check
turnstile.unavailable: The security check isn’t available right now. You can reset your password in the meantime.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: With an account you can pay for your orders and track them.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: You can browse the menu and build your order without an account. To pay, you need an account with a confirmed email.
register.doneBody: If {{email}} didn’t have an account, we sent a link to confirm it. It’s valid for 24 hours.
register.doneNext: Once you confirm it, sign in.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.successBody: All set: you can now pay for your orders.
verify.failedBody: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one from your account.
verify.pendingBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it from that email to confirm it’s yours.
verify.noToken: Open the link we emailed you to confirm your account.
verify.resent: We sent you a new link. The previous ones no longer work.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.doneBody: If {{email}} has an account, we sent you a link. It’s valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Changing it signs you out of every open session.
reset.noToken: Open the link we emailed you to choose a new password.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

profile.title: Your account
profile.unverifiedStatus: Email not confirmed: confirm it to be able to pay.
profile.passwordIntro: Changing it signs you out of your other open sessions.
profile.passwordSaved: We changed your password and signed out your other sessions.
profile.signOutAllHint: On this and all your devices.
